headline: Summer Resort Lodging and Assateague Entry
reservation: Oceanfront hotels and bayside rentals require booking 4-6 months in advance for July and August. While the beach itself does not require a permit, Assateague Island National Seashore requires a separate park entrance fee or valid pass. During peak weekends, parking at the southern Inlet lot fills early and may require using the municipal Beach Bus system.

days.title: Boardwalk Heritage and Coastal Amusements

stops.name: Ocean City Life-Saving Station Museum
stops.detail: Explore the maritime history of the Delmarva Peninsula and 19th-century coastal rescues.

stops.name: Trimper Rides
stops.detail: Experience the historic wooden carousel and classic amusements at the boardwalk's southern end.

days.driving: Walking or local transfer recommended; allow 20 minutes for the Beach Bus.
days.note: Boardwalk biking is restricted to early morning hours during the summer season.

days.title: Wild Coastal Landscapes
days.start: Suggested: 8 AM from West Ocean City

stops.name: Assateague Island National Seashore
stops.detail: View wild horses and hike the Life of the Dunes trail through maritime scrub.

stops.name: Sinepuxent Bay
stops.detail: Launch a kayak or paddleboard into the calm marshes to observe herons and ospreys.

days.driving: Allow 30 to 45 minutes for the drive south; parking at Assateague can be competitive.
days.note: Maintain a legal distance from wild horses and prepare for marsh mosquitoes.

days.title: Bayside Adventure and Historic Berlin

stops.name: Isle of Wight Bay
stops.detail: Engage in water sports or take a sunset cruise to spot dolphins in the coastal wake.

stops.name: Historic Berlin Main Street
stops.detail: Visit the nearby 'coolest small town' for boutique shopping and Victorian architecture.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for the round trip to Berlin; traffic on Route 50 varies seasonally.
days.note: Dining reservations are highly recommended for bayside crab houses on weekends.

intel.title: Inlet and Street Parking
intel.text: The Inlet parking lot uses a plate-reader system; residential street parking is restricted in many zones. Utilize the park-and-ride lot in West Ocean City to avoid central congestion.

intel.title: Beach Regulations
intel.text: Ocean City beaches are open to the public, but smoking is restricted to designated areas. Verify current surfing zones as they rotate throughout the day for swimmer safety.

intel.title: Boardwalk Crowds
intel.text: Visit the boardwalk before 10 AM for a quiet experience and easier biking access. Evening crowds peak between 7 PM and 10 PM near the amusement piers.

intel.title: Mainland Services
intel.text: Fuel prices are often lower on the mainland in Berlin or Salisbury compared to Coastal Highway. Refill before crossing the bridge if heading west.

intel.title: Coastal Connectivity
intel.text: Strong 5G coverage is standard throughout the city and boardwalk. Reception may drop significantly once inside the Assateague Island National Seashore boundaries.

plan.arrival: Land at OCE or arrive via Route 50; check into hotel and utilize the Beach Bus for boardwalk access.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable; beach driving requires a specific permit and equipment for Assateague's OSV zone.
plan.goldenHour: Isle of Wight Bay piers for sunset over the water; seasonal clouds vary visibility.
